description: This Java class defines configuration properties for an MQTT protocol adapter within the Eclipse Hono project. It includes a property for command acknowledgment timeout, with getter and setter methods, and extends a base properties class.

classes.name: MqttProtocolAdapterProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties class for MQTT protocol adapter, managing the command acknowledgment timeout setting.

methods.name: getCommandAckTimeout
methods.description: Returns the current command acknowledgment timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: setCommandAckTimeout
methods.description: Sets the command acknowledgment timeout in milliseconds; throws IllegalArgumentException if input is negative.
